```{python}
#| label: fig-bench-multidim
#| fig-cap: "Multi-dimensional search at scale (origin + creator + time range): the coordinate-tree path (iter_prefix) versus the record-map scan. The gap widens as records accumulate: 6x to 25x at 100k, 5x to 47x at 1m facts."
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

labels = ['100k\nwide', '100k\nnarrow', '1m\nwide', '1m\nnarrow']
scan = [1440.0, 940.0, 25300.0, 18600.0]   # microseconds, record-map scan
struc = [257.0, 37.4, 5000.0, 398.0]       # microseconds, coordinate tree

fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(5.2, 3.2))
x = range(len(labels))
w = 0.35
ax.bar([i - w / 2 for i in x], scan, w, color='white', edgecolor='black',
       linewidth=0.8, hatch='///', label='Record-map scan')
ax.bar([i + w / 2 for i in x], struc, w, color='white', edgecolor='black',
       linewidth=0.8, label='Coordinate tree')
ax.set_xticks(list(x))
ax.set_xticklabels(labels)
ax.set_ylabel('Time per query (µs)')
ax.set_yscale('log')
ax.set_ylim(10, 100_000)

for i, (s, t) in enumerate(zip(scan, struc)):
    fmt = lambda v: f'{v / 1000:.1f} ms' if v >= 1000 else f'{v:.0f} µs'
    ax.text(i - w / 2, s * 1.15, fmt(s), ha='center', va='bottom', fontsize=7)
    ax.text(i + w / 2, t * 1.15, fmt(t), ha='center', va='bottom', fontsize=7)

ax.legend(fontsize=7, loc='upper left')
plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()
```
